title: Refine T003 from accepted T002 cached-continuation evidence
objective: Replace the disproven broad local-transformation hypothesis with a bounded Codex cached-continuation recovery contract derived from accepted T002 evidence.

patch.title: Recover Codex cached continuation when server-side tool-call state is missing
patch.description: Accepted T002 evidence proves the matching tool call/result survives buildSessionContext, the real extension context-hook pipeline, convertToLlm/transformMessages, OpenAI Responses conversion, the first full-context Codex request, and deterministic cached-delta construction. The remaining bounded failure mode is stale or missing server-side continuation state: a valid cached delta can contain function_call_output while relying on previous_response_id for the earlier function_call, and Codex may reject it with `No tool call found for function call output with call_id ...`. Harden the OpenAI Codex cached WebSocket boundary so this exact continuation-state failure invalidates the cached continuation and retries once with the already-coherent full request body, while a full-context failure propagates without loops. Do not synthesize, drop, reorder, or rewrite spans in canonical transformation layers that T002 proved coherent.

acceptanceCriteria: A cached WebSocket request that uses previous_response_id and is rejected with the exact Codex orphan function_call_output/tool-call-state failure is treated as a stale continuation, invalidates that continuation, and retries exactly once with the coherent full request body and no previous_response_id.

The recovery is enabled only when the failed request actually used cached continuation semantics; the same provider error from a full-context request is propagated without retry loops or speculative rewriting.

The full-context retry preserves the exact matching function_call/function_call_output call_id and chronology already proven by T002, including foreign IDs and Responses item-id suffix normalization handled by existing conversion.
Valid websocket-cached deltas remain delta-only and keep existing performance/continuation semantics; previous_response_not_found recovery remains passing.
No synthetic or real result is duplicated, dropped, or rewritten, and genuine error content such as `Command aborted` remains unchanged.

Offline tests capture the failed cached-delta body and the one-shot full-context retry body, assert connection/previous_response_id behavior, and cover the exact T002 incident call-id shape without a live provider.

No live paid-provider request or personal-session mutation occurs. Production edits are limited to packages/ai/src/api/openai-codex-responses.ts, with regressions in packages/ai/test/openai-codex-stream.test.ts and an Unreleased packages/ai changelog entry.

Implementation stays on the existing pg/ext/tool-span-coherence-tasks worktree because T002 did not demonstrate an upstream-parity local transformation bug; npm run check, focused packages/ai tests, fresh completion evidence, and required independent review must pass.
patch.notes: T002 accepted diagnosis on commit 13cc56836: no local projection divergence; residual hypothesis is remote Codex cached continuation/state validation. Implement only bounded provider-boundary recovery. Do not edit stable main/pg/daily, resolve remote divergence, or touch unrelated .pi-subagents/FORK_RESTRUCTURE.md.
